title: Longest Substring Of All Vowels in Order
summary: Determine the length of the longest substring in a given string of vowels that contains each of the five vowels ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') exactly once and in alphabetical order.
statement: Determine the length of the longest substring in a given string of vowels that contains each of the five vowels ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') exactly once and in alphabetical order. If no such substring exists, return 0.
constraints: word contains only vowels; a beautiful substring has one or more of each a,e,i,o,u in nondecreasing order.
Return the greatest beautiful-substring length, or zero if none exists.
hints: Within a candidate run, vowel characters may stay equal or increase but never decrease.
Track the run start and the number of strict vowel transitions.
Reset on a decrease; a run becomes beautiful after reaching five distinct vowel groups.
Because the alphabet is restricted to vowels, a nondecreasing run with five groups contains all five in order; every decrease is a necessary boundary.
editorial: Because the alphabet is restricted to vowels, a nondecreasing run with five groups contains all five in order; every decrease is a necessary boundary.

tests.explanation: The longest ordered run containing all five vowel groups has length thirteen.
The final aeiou is the longest complete ordered run, length five.
